content.help: Turns F4SR upscaling on or off. Applies when you close the menu.
FSR 4.1: best image quality, highest GPU cost (runs as INT8 on RDNA3). FSR 3.1: lowest cost. XeSS: Intel's upscaler, runs on any GPU. Applies when you close the menu.

Resolution the game renders at before upscaling, per axis. Native keeps full resolution and only replaces the game's anti-aliasing. Lower settings are faster and softer. Applies when you close the menu.
FSR's sharpening (RCAS). 0 turns it off. XeSS ignores it. If ENB also sharpens, keep this low or at 0.
Marks pixels changed by transparent effects (particles, fire, glass, water) so the upscaler does not smear or ghost them. Recommended on. Turning it on takes effect after a game restart.
Shows generated frames between rendered ones for smoother motion. Adds a little input latency; works best on a variable-refresh (FreeSync / G-Sync) display. Switches live.
FSR-FG: AMD frame generation, 2X. XeSS-FG: Intel frame generation, 2X to 4X (multiplier below). Restart the game after changing this.

Frames shown per rendered frame: 3X shows two generated frames for each real one. Pick the value where real FPS x multiplier is close to your refresh rate; going higher adds latency without adding visible frames. Applies live.

content.text: Allow Lower Render Resolutions with ENB
content.help: Allows Quality / Balanced / Performance while ENB is installed. The image is upscaled before ENB's post-processing, so ENB still works at full resolution. Native works either way.
Small panel in the top-left corner: upscaler, render and output resolution, upscaler GPU time, frame generation rate. Switches live.
Replaces the image with FidelityFX's debug view (motion vectors, reactive mask). For troubleshooting only.
Troubleshooting: clears the upscaler's history every frame. If ghosting disappears with this on, the problem is in the motion vectors.
Developer diagnostic: saves a few frame-generation sample images to the game folder. May stutter briefly. Leave off.
